chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Sayyari, from Yahya ibn Abi Rafi'a and others, they raise it to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him).
He said: 'Nothing remains in the stomach from the early morning until the night except rice bread.'

key_terms.الْجَوْف: The stomach or cavity of the body

ai.seo_question: What is the digestive characteristic of rice bread according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the unique digestive property of rice bread (*khubz al-aruzz*), noting that it passes through the stomach from morning until evening. This description underscores its status in Shia medical tradition as a light, easily assimilated food suitable for maintaining bodily ease and health, reflecting the Prophetic emphasis on moderation and the specific benefits of staple grains.
